recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future public-health MeasureReport structural or example refinements should be handled under their own CQI trackers rather than reopening this already-applied STU3 example request.
issue_request: FHIR-13863 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CQI issue asking to expand MeasureReport description/examples beyond clinical data to include population health measures. Its resolution was to include a population health reporting example as described in the follow-up.
initial_application: GF#13863 commit 464fe3741d added the HIV Indicators Measure, Library, and MeasureReport public health reporting examples. A nearby historical cleanup commit, 1ce7bae0e8, also touched Measure/MeasureReport public health reporting use cases, though its old GF#14908 reference maps to an unrelated current Jira issue.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini, the active MeasureReport example list includes the HIV Indicators public health data-elements report, and the current Quality Reporting guidance covers public health indicators and population analytics measures. Later CQI work such as FHIR-49824 and FHIR-32985 updated the surrounding MeasureReport guidance/examples without reversing this applied example.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source preserves the requested public/population health example and is not misleadingly limited to clinical-only reporting.
